source: CareScout (Genworth), Cost of Care Survey 2025, Median Cost Data Tables (survey July through November 2025; document 282102, 2026-03-02): California rows of the Monthly, Daily and Home Care Median Costs tables, https://assets.carescout.com/x/8fcb50422f/282102.pdf

A Place for Mom, Senior Living Cost Planner (published 2026-02-20), https://www.aplaceformom.com/senior-living-cost-planner: California memory care median $6,850 a month (2025 move-ins) reads below CareScout's assisted living figure, so memory care is estimated at assisted living plus 25% (industry surveys put memory care about 20-30% above assisted living)

adult_day_daily.what: Adult day health care, median daily rate

assisted_living_monthly.what: Assisted living (a residential care facility in California), private one bedroom, median monthly rate

memory_care_monthly.what: Memory care, estimated as the assisted living median ($7,000) plus 25%

nursing_home_shared_monthly.what: Nursing home, semi-private room, the annual median divided by 12

nursing_home_private_monthly.what: Nursing home, private room, the annual median divided by 12
